patch.description:
Phase 57 / 56.3.B — role + department updates from the roster UI.

Accepts (both optional in a single call):
  • ``department`` — one of `pool | landscaping | both | null`.
  • ``role``       — one of `admin | technician`. `super_admin`
                     cannot be assigned or removed via this endpoint.

Guardrails:
  • Only admin / super_admin (via `require_admin`) can call.
  • `super_admin` targets are protected — 403 with a clean message.
  • Callers cannot change their own role (self-demotion attack).
  • Assigning `role = "admin"` clears `department` (admins have no
    department concept in this app).
  • Unknown fields → 400 so we don't silently accept e.g. `password`.
Emits a Phase-55 notification to the target user AND all tenant
admins, and writes an audit-log row.

  3. low_accuracy

  5. out_of_time_window           (a geofence match exists but not in ±2h)

Public quote submission endpoint. NO auth.

**Server always recomputes the total** from the config — client-supplied totals are ignored. Qty is clamped to per-service `min_qty` / `max_qty`. Add-on selections are filtered against the service's allow-list. Discount rules (`if.service_id + min_qty → then.discount_pct`) are applied last.

Rate-limit: 3 submissions per IP per 10 min. Honeypot: any non-empty `_hp` value causes a real-shaped ack without persistence.

get.description:
Compose a single 0-100 citation score + surface the most
valuable missing directories.

Scoring
-------
Base score = 100 * (verified_count / total_available), with:
  * ``submitted`` counted at 60% weight,
  * ``needs_update`` counted at 30% weight,
  * ``in_progress`` counted at 20% weight,
  * everything else at 0.
Then average with ``avg_nap_match_score`` when a scan has run,
so a tenant with lots of verified profiles but inconsistent NAP
data can never score higher than a tenant with fewer but cleaner
citations. Overall score is clamped to [0, 100].
